_meta.purpose: Machine-readable registry of known ADR-contradiction pairs. Consumed by oya-check-adr-index --sub-check=contradiction-graph (M02-P20 IP-005 expansion). Each row declares a pair of ADRs that are simultaneously Accepted but mutually contradictory; the lane fails if no supersession edge resolves the pair by its declared resolution_trigger.

contradictions.adr_a_title: Hyper canonical HTTP backbone (LTS-exception for hyper 1.x)
contradictions.adr_b_status: Proposed (R5 plan pending architect+critic+codex consensus; ADR not yet drafted on disk at HEAD 4d6bf91)
contradictions.contradiction_summary: ADR-0090 declares hyper 1.x as canonical HTTP backbone with 'Support everything ourselves with 0-to-minimal-dependency' framing (i.e., long-term retention). ADR-0091 (per R5) declares the same hyper stack as known-debt under a phase-out trajectory (target replacement: std-only, post-ontology-v1-stable). Both ADRs covering the same scope cannot be simultaneously Accepted without an explicit supersession edge.
contradictions.resolution_strategy: ADR-0091 supersedes ADR-0090 (per .omc/plans/ralplan-ops-freelance-realignment-2026-05-14.md §6(c) + R5 §8 ADR-0091 outline). ADR-0090 body remains factual (it accurately describes the current backbone); status flips to 'Superseded by ADR-0091' in the same atomic PR as ADR-0091 Accepted.

resolution_trigger.deadline_rationale: M02 exit gate requires zero unresolved contradictions per masterplan §Consequences (dispatched in autopilot Phase 2).

honest_gaps: Only 1 row seeded at HEAD; future contradictions added as discovered (e.g., by oya-check-adr-index lane finding 'adr-mutual-accepted-no-supersession').
Schema lacks a 'discovered_by_lane_run_id' field today; add at M02-P20 IP-005 expansion when lane authoring lands.
